Interface CustomCollection<E>

All Superinterfaces:
Iterable<E>
All Known Implementing Classes:
FIFOQueue, LIFOQueue, PRIOQueue
public interface CustomCollection<E> extends Iterable<E>
Interface that simulates the beheviour of the Collection interface in Java. This interface acts as a supertype for all the types of queue used in the station, like FIFO, LIFO, Priority
